text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, haah...! 
...Ngh. How utterly disgraceful...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...I fell short. But it was not 
simply that I fell short.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(My spirit was bested. The chance for 
victory was there. 
Yet, I lacked the resolve to wring out 
that final step.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I believed I stood shoulder to shoulder 
with my peers. 
Never did I imagine such a gulf existed...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! That was a magnificent race! 
You were amazing, Spe-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You too, El-chan! 
You truly were the "Monster Bird"!
(Wooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats!" "What an exciting race!" 
"Man, that was something to see!" 
"Lately, the races have been so 
thrilling!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(And... what is this fervor...? 
A "groundswell" that I could never hope to 
create alone.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... That was seriously amazing! 
So this is the level of Japanese racing 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, they could take on the 
world...! 
Heh! I'm definitely coming back to cheer 
for you again!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The fervor El and the others sparked 
today— 
has convinced even the spectators.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of the sheer "strength" of the Japanese 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(El and her rivals' races hold the 
power... 
to transmit that conviction to all who 
watch.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the kind of race 
they are forging...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...I have returned.
choice_data_list: Welcome back, great job out there...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I thank you for your kind words. 
Yet, surely you must see it as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I was bested in my hunger for victory. 
My conviction to conquer them was lacking.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have shown you a weak and frail side of 
myself. 
Forgive me...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No. 
If so, then I need only catch up.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
By running alongside them, I bore witness 
to their caliber. 
One day I shall overtake them and conquer 
them head-on. 
To that end, I will cultivate my 
fundamental strength.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And that "groundswell" they brought about— 
I shall create it as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Only beyond such an achievement 
lies the prosperity of the Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us return to the academy, 
Trainer. 
We must continue our diligent efforts.

Having run the Japan Cup, Phalaenopsis 
seemed 
to have felt something profound. I prayed 
that this 
would serve as a positive catalyst for 
her—
